summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated sibling payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` script that runs `node setup.mjs`. `setup.mjs` downloads a Bun runtime ZIP from oven-sh's GitHub releases into a temp directory, extracts and chmods the `bun`/`bun.exe` binary, and then invokes it via `execFileSync` against a sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a 727KB heavily obfuscated file marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` — it uses a rotating string-array decoder (identifiers such as `n7gIxM`, `WV8StW`, `MmgoCP`) and is only interpretable under the Bun runtime, preventing inspection under Node. The advertised purpose is a Vue condition-builder UI component, which has no legitimate need to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time or to execute an obfuscated non-Node payload. The combination of a lifecycle-triggered download of an alien runtime plus execution of an obfuscated sibling under it is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern, and causes attacker-selected code to run on the installer's machine on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
